title: Placed turrets never acquire targets, rotate or fire: no turret behavior is registered and no turret update pass runs in the shipped client

path.to: in-engine: campaign Ground Zero -> research/build `duo`, feed copper ammo, spawn an enemy in range, step 600 ticks

confirm.assertion: a placed turret with ammo fires at an enemy and its total_shots/ammo change
confirm.java_expected: duo fires BasicBulletType(2.5, 9) every 20 ticks and the target loses HP
confirm.godot_expected: the placed entity has no TurretState; 0 shots and 0 bullets ever; target HP unchanged

java: Run the pinned JVM Mindustry (computer-mcp), open a custom game.
Place a `duo`, feed it `copper` from a core/conveyor, spawn a wave enemy inside range and observe rotation + projectiles.
godot: Launch the Godot client (open-godot-mcp) on Ground Zero or a custom map and place a `duo` fed `copper`.
Spawn an enemy in range, step 600 ticks via MindSimHost.step, then read MindSimHost.get_state_json(): no turret state/bullets and the target takes no damage.
compare: Java: turret tracks and fires; Godot: the turret is inert because `default_registry` installs `NoopBehavior` for every turret kind and nothing calls `update_turrets`.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: `defense::register` gates `TurretBehavior` on the harness-only `FIXTURE_NAMES` map (behaviors.rs:424) and the live `UnitRuntime` pass never calls `turrets::update_turrets` (only `CombatHarness` does, harness.rs:688).
plan.approach: 1) Register the turret ammo bullets in base content: call `turrets::register_bullets` from `create_base_content` right after the blocks wave (upstream constructs turret ammo in Blocks.java after UnitTypes.load), so the ~90 ammo bullets join the base bullet ids; keep the name map but populate it at boot instead of in the harness. 2) Make `defense::register` register every `TURRET_BLOCKS` entry unconditionally (drop the `fixture_names()` gate). 3) Drive `turrets::update_turrets` from a live system in `sim/unit_runtime.rs` (after `weapons::update_weapons`, before `bullet_update_system`) with the same `CombatCtx`. 4) Remove the harness-side duplicate registration in `CombatHarness::new` once step 1 lands.
plan.narrow_check: new mind-core test: `default_registry(&create_base_content(...)).get_named("duo")` resolves to a `TurretBehavior` with 3 item ammo entries (currently `None` -> NoopBehavior), and a headless scenario asserts a fed `duo`'s `total_shots > 0` against an in-range enemy.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (combat): S2 high. All 29 vanilla turret blocks resolve to `NoopBehavior` in the shipped client: `FIXTURE_NAMES` is set only by `CombatHarness` (test-only), `default_behavior` maps every turret kind to `NoopBehavior` (behavior/mod.rs:573), `create_state` default inserts nothing, and no live system calls `update_turrets`, so placed turrets never rotate, shoot, consume ammo or accept coolant. The JVM bullet count 202 vs rust 112 (parity/reports/jvm_golden_diff.md:12) is the same root cause: ~90 turret-ammo bullets live only in the harness fixture map. In-engine verification pending.

title: Turret coolant cannot be supplied: water/cryofluid is rejected by item/power turrets and 19 turret blocks report has_liquids=false

path.to: in-engine (after the turret-behavior fix): place `duo`, run a water conduit into it, compare the liquid bar and reload time

confirm.assertion: water flows into a `duo` and raises its reload rate
confirm.java_expected: liquid bar fills; ReloadTurret.updateCooling adds amount * edelta * heatCapacity * coolantMultiplier to reloadCounter
confirm.godot_expected: accept_liquid(water) returns false, LiquidModule stays empty, coolant reload boost at turrets/mod.rs:1271 is unreachable

java: Place `duo`, connect a water conduit: the liquid bar fills and the reload speed increases by coolantMultiplier * heatCapacity (JVM).
godot: Call `accept_liquid(water)` on a placed `duo` (or run a conduit into it): the port returns false for `TurretAmmo::Item` and no liquid is stored; the JVM golden diff shows `has_liquids False -> True` for duo/scatter/scorch/hail/lancer/arc/swarmer/salvo/fuse/ripple/cyclone/foreshadow/spectre/meltdown/breach/diffuse/disperse/scathe/smite.
compare: JVM content dump: 19 turret rows has_liquids=true; rust generated specs have no coolant consumer. In-game: coolant can never enter an item/power turret, so the already-ported `updateCooling` reload boost is dead.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: The generated turret block specs omit the upstream coolant consumers (so `has_liquids` stays false) and `TurretBehavior::accept_liquid` only accepts the Liquid-ammo family.
plan.approach: 1) Add coolant consumers to the 20 turret specs from upstream: 14 Serpulo `consume_coolant(amount, true, false)` (duo 0.1, scatter 0.2, scorch 0.1, hail 0.1, lancer 0.2, arc 0.1, swarmer 0.3, salvo 0.2, fuse 0.3, ripple 0.3, cyclone 0.3, foreshadow 1.0, spectre 1.0, meltdown 0.5) and 6 Erekir `consume_liquid("water", x/60)` (breach 15, diffuse 15, titan 30, disperse 20, scathe 15, smite 15; titan keeps hydrogen). 2) Carry a coolant gate into `TurretConfig` and make `TurretBehavior::accept_liquid` accept coolant liquids matching the upstream filter (coolant flag, temperature < 0.5, flammability < 0.1, allow_liquid/allow_gas) while still rejecting ammo-liquids on Item/Power turrets. 3) Route `handle_liquid` into the LiquidModule at the block liquid capacity (replace the hardcoded 60.0 at turrets/mod.rs:975). 4) Keep `handle_reload`'s coolant boost as the consumer.
plan.narrow_check: new test `placed_turret_accepts_coolant`: `accept_liquid(world, duo, water) == true`, `handle_liquid` fills the LiquidModule, and 10 ticks with water accumulate more `reload_counter` than without; the JVM-diff row for duo flips `has_liquids` to true.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (combat): S3 high. JVM golden diff rows 45-63 are the machine-checkable symptom (`has_liquids` False -> True for 19 turrets) and titan additionally lacks its upstream water coolant; the port's generated specs never emit a coolant consumer even though `consume_coolant`/`Consume::Coolant` exist (blocks/mod.rs:1900, world/consumers.rs:165). Masked by the turret-inert finding above: even with consumers added, `accept_liquid` rejects non-ammo liquids, and `TurretBehavior::handle_liquid` hardcodes a 60-unit capacity for Liquid turrets (upstream wave=10, tsunami=40). In-engine verification pending.

title: Bullets with a spawnUnit payload never spawn their unit: scathe volleys and the anthicus/quell/disrupt missile weapons deal no damage

path.to: harness: place `scathe` in a CombatHarness, feed carbide, step 200 ticks, assert a `scathe-missile` unit entity exists

confirm.assertion: firing a spawnUnit bullet creates the unit and removes the carrier bullet
confirm.java_expected: a `scathe-missile` MissileUnitType spawns from the fired bullet, flies and detonates (BulletType.init spawnUnit branch)
confirm.godot_expected: the ammo bullet is a zero-speed Empty bullet; no unit is ever spawned and the target HP is unchanged

java: Place `scathe`, feed `carbide`, target an enemy: a `scathe-missile` unit spawns from the fired bullet, flies to the target and detonates.
godot: Harness: `turret_at(&mut harness, "scathe")` + 12 carbide, 200 ticks -> `total_shots > 0` but no unit entity appears and the target HP is unchanged (the shipped client has no live turret pass yet, see the turret-inert finding).
compare: JVM unit dump has 70 units incl. scathe-missile/-phase/-surge/-surge-split; rust has 65. `BulletDef.spawn_unit` is populated for anthicus/quell/disrupt weapon bullets (units/erekir.rs:1616/2661/2774) but no runtime path reads it.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: `BulletBehavior`/bullet creation never consumes `BulletDef.spawn_unit` (upstream `BulletType.init` spawnUnit branch), and the `scathe_*` ammo bullets are registered as `BulletKind::Empty` with no `spawn_unit` and no missile unit defs.
plan.approach: 1) Port `BulletType.init`'s spawnUnit branch: on bullet create, when `def.spawn_unit` is set and the host is not a net client, spawn that unit at the bullet position with the shooter team, apply speed/angle/`missileAccelTime` velocity, and remove the bullet; route through `entities/comp/unit/lifecycle::spawn_unit` so it is checksum-visible. 2) Register the four Erekir MissileUnitType defs (`scathe-missile`, `-phase`, `-surge`, `-surge-split`) in the Erekir unit wave and point `scathe_carbide/phase/surge` at them via `spawn_unit`. 3) Add `despawnUnit`/`despawnUnitChance` handling in the same branch (`BulletType.despawned`).
plan.narrow_check: new combat scenario `scathe_missile_spawns`: spawn a `scathe_carbide` bullet, step 1 tick, assert a unit entity of the `scathe-missile` content exists and the carrier bullet is gone; content test: `create_base_content` unit count reaches 70.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (combat): S2 high. `BulletDef.spawn_unit` is metadata-only: `hit_bullet` explicitly leaves createUnits to a later milestone (combat/bullet/mod.rs:593) and `BulletBehavior::init` never spawns. scathe's whole damage lives in the missile unit (the carrier bullet is 0 damage), so the turret is harmless even after the turret-inert fix; the same dead path makes anthicus/quell/disrupt missile attacks no-ops. Unit count diff 65 vs 70 (jvm_golden_diff.md:19) covers the four scathe missiles plus build-tower. In-engine verification pending.

title: Sublimate fires with any trace of fuel and never consumes ozone/cyanogen (no liquid activation window)

path.to: harness: place `sublimate`, inject 1.0 ozone (below the 4-tick activation threshold), step 120 ticks and assert no beam and no liquid drain

confirm.assertion: sublimate only starts firing after 4 continuous ticks of liquid consumption and deactivates below liquidConsumed
confirm.java_expected: activated latch (>= liquidConsumed*4) gates hasAmmo/shouldConsume; hasAmmo is false while !activated
confirm.godot_expected: beam spawns whenever LiquidModule holds >= 1/ammoMultiplier; no activated state and no consumption at all

java: Place `sublimate`, inject <1.2 units of ozone: it stays inactive (no beam, no liquid drain); with steady supply it activates after 4 consumed ticks and deactivates below 0.3.
godot: Harness `sublimate_liquid_beam_spawns_with_ozone` (advanced.rs:2355) shows the beam spawning from a single injection; with any trace (<1.2) the port still fires, the liquid module is never drained, and `newTargetInterval` 30 is not modeled (target timer always uses target_interval 5).
compare: Java: activation window + ConsumeLiquidFilter(liquidConsumed = 18/60, multiplier 1/ammoMultiplier) drains the tank while firing; Godot: no activation latch, no consumer, so the beam is fuel-free and fires from a trace.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: `ContinuousLiquidTurret`'s `activated` latch plus `shouldConsume`/`hasAmmo` gating and its `ConsumeLiquidFilter(liquidConsumed)` are not modeled; `update_continuous` (advanced.rs:1893) fires on `has_ammo_state` alone and no consumer drains the tank.
plan.approach: 1) Add an `activated` flag for the continuous-liquid turret (new `TurretState` field or reuse the `any` slot) with upstream transitions each tick from the LiquidModule (`>= liquid_consumed * 4` set, `< liquid_consumed` clear). 2) Gate `has_ammo_state`/`can_consume` for sublimate on it and add `new_target_interval` (upstream 30) to the target timer instead of always `target_interval`. 3) Register the `ConsumeLiquidFilter` for ozone/cyanogen (`liquidConsumed = 18/60`, multiplier `1/ammoMultiplier`) on the sublimate block spec so the tank drains while firing.
plan.narrow_check: new test `sublimate_activation_window`: 1.0 ozone -> no beam and no liquid removed; 2.0 ozone -> beam spawns after 4 ticks, liquid decreases per firing tick, and activation clears below 0.3.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (combat): S3 high. parity/ledgers/combat.md already marks `ContinuousLiquidTurret` `[~] partial` for exactly this window, and the port comment at advanced.rs:1580 admits consumption is left to a plan-07/08 consumer that the sublimate block spec never registers (turrets.rs:410 has has_liquids/liquid_capacity but no `consumes`). Observable once the turret-inert finding is fixed: sublimate fires with a trace of fuel and the liquid never drains. In-engine verification pending.

title: Save/load drops all fires and puddles: no entity save path reaches their codecs

path.to: headless io round-trip: create a fire and a puddle in the live world, save through SimIoHandler, load, assert both survive

confirm.assertion: a saved sector reloads with its fires and puddles intact
confirm.java_expected: writeWorldEntities writes every Groups.all serializable entity incl. Fire/Puddle and readWorldEntities re-adds them
confirm.godot_expected: SimIoHandler writes only SIM_UNIT_CLASS_ID chunks; FireState/PuddleState are never written and entity_defs() only lists BuildingComp

java: Ignite a tile (or spawn a fire) and deposit a puddle, Save & Quit, reload the sector: both are still present and resume ticking.
godot: Create a FireState and a PuddleState in the live sim world, run SimIoHandler Capture+Apply (or SaveSlot round-trip): after load neither entity exists; `write_fire`/`write_puddle` are only referenced by their own unit tests.
compare: Java persists transient combat tile entities; Godot's entities region contains only live units, so burning ground/pools vanish across save/load.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: `define_entity_defs!` only lists `BuildingComp` and `SimIoHandler::write_entities` writes only live units, so the Fire/Puddle save codecs are unreachable outside tests.
plan.approach: 1) Implement `EntityCodec` for `FireState`/`PuddleState` (reserved class ids 10/13) delegating to the existing `write_fire`/`read_fire` and `write_puddle`/`read_puddle` helpers. 2) Append both defs to `define_entity_defs!` in io/entity/registry.rs. 3) Extend the live `SimIoHandler` entity writer and `LiveEntitySink` to emit/collect those two classes and relink `tile`/tile-slot caches on load (afterReadAll equivalent).
plan.narrow_check: cargo test -p mind-core io: a round-trip fixture with one burning tile and one puddle restores both after load (currently the entities region reports zero non-unit entities).

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (combat): S3 high (save/load loses transient combat state). plans/24_DEFERRED_ITEMS_SWEEP_PLAN.md:147 lists the registry append as the fix; upstream writes Fire/Puddle through Groups.all in writeWorldEntities (SaveVersion.java:423). Reachability is currently gated by the fire/puddle update gap below (there is little live fire content yet), but the codecs and helpers already exist and are unreachable. In-engine verification pending.

title: Deposited puddles never react, evaporate or apply status: no live fire/puddle update system runs

path.to: in-engine: let an `atrax` (or any liquid bullet) hit a building, then watch the slag puddle for 300 ticks

confirm.assertion: a deposited puddle spreads/evaporates/reacts and a fire changes over time in the live sim
confirm.java_expected: Logic.java:475 Groups.all.update() drives FireComp.update/PuddleComp.update every tick
confirm.godot_expected: update_puddles/update_fires are only reachable from CombatHarness.fire_tick/puddle_tick; the live UnitRuntime systems never call them

java: Let a slag/pyratite weapon hit near a building: the puddle spreads to neighbors, reacts/evaporates, and fire deals tile/unit damage, spreads and burns out.
godot: Harness or live runtime: deposit a puddle with `puddles::deposit` (e.g. atrax slag bullet, units/standard.rs:817), step 300 live-runtime ticks: `update_time` stays 0, amount never changes, no reaction/evaporation; a FireState created via `fires::create` never advances `time` or damages anything.
compare: Java runs Fires/Puddles update each tick through Groups.all; Godot only runs them in the test harness, so live puddles are frozen decals and fires are inert markers.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: `update_fires`/`update_puddles` are only called from `CombatHarness::{fire_tick,puddle_tick}`; the live `UnitRuntime` systems (`unit_update_system`, `bullet_update_system`) never schedule them.
plan.approach: 1) Add a live fire/puddle system to `sim/unit_runtime.rs` (after the bullet update, alongside the existing unit/bullet systems) that borrows the tile cache and calls `fires::update_fires` + `puddles::update_puddles` with the runtime `SimRng`, fx/audio sinks and the CombatEnv water attribute. 2) Register it in the reserved schedule slot (or the UnitRuntime tick) so headless and in-engine runs share it. 3) Feed the plan-06/12 water attribute so fire decay matches upstream, and (follow-up) port `BulletType.createIncend`/`makeFire` (BulletType.java:591-593) so incendiary bullets can actually ignite.
plan.narrow_check: cargo test -p mind-core: deposit a puddle, step 120 live ticks and assert `PuddleState.update_time`/amount changed and a flammable-hot reaction created/removed fire; create a fire and assert `FireState.time` advances and an adjacent flammable tile catches.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (combat): S2 high. The puddle half is live-reachable today: atrax fires a Liquid bullet (units/standard.rs:817) whose hit calls `puddles::deposit`, and the resulting puddle never updates. The fire half is currently unreachable because no live content creates fires (BulletType.createIncend/makeFire are unported, BulletType.java:591-593 vs the explicit TODO at combat/bullet/mod.rs:593) — the same scheduling gap would leave any fire inert once one is created, e.g. through `react_puddle` (puddles.rs:180). In-engine verification pending.
